hypotheses.justification: The statement only uses `G`, `E`, `𝒦 = AutomorphicForm.semiLocalIntegralSet K L v` and `𝒪 = AutomorphicForm.semiLocalIntegers K L v`, with matrix entries and inverses. None of this needs `NumberField L`. In Definitions/Def_AutomorphicForm_TwistedOrbital.lean the same section variables are in force (Field K, NumberField K, Field L, NumberField L, Algebra K L). There, `zero_mem_semiLocalIntegers`, `one_mem_semiLocalIntegers` and `one_mem_semiLocalIntegralSet` are stated with `omit [NumberField L] in`, and they mention `semiLocalIntegers K L v` and `semiLocalIntegralSet K L v`. Those lemmas compile, so the two definitions do not take `[NumberField L]` as an argument. `semiLocalIntegers` is a `Set.range` of `tensorAdicCompletionIntegersTo`, and the lemmas about that map omit the Dedekind, integrality and fraction-ring hypotheses on `𝓞 L`. So the statement elaborates without `[NumberField L]`. It stays true, since it is just the definitional unfolding of `integralUnitsSet`. The proof `Iff.rfl` does not use the instance, so it still works if `[NumberField L]` is dropped with `omit [NumberField L] in`.
